eventContract.budgetLimit: These are scorer intake caps below existing capture ceilings, not increases to actual frozen per-session limits. Actual lower configured cap/deadline exhaustion remains incomplete; no retry/cleanup allowance invented.
eventContract.exception: Failure fields exact type,message,errno; AssertionError acceptance requires builtins.AssertionError in call/observed subtest only. Complete other call exceptions retain phase/type and unresolved semantic-error class; no broad exception-as-assertion policy.
eventContract.order: run-start; root suite-start/collection/case phase lifecycle/suite-end; backend counterpart; run-end. Per-case phases ordered; missing phases retained as noncompletion. Both suites must finish even after complete assertion failure; fail-fast/missing cases is noncompletion.

rootUnittestObserver.required: Observe native loader/result plus actual setup/call/teardown/doCleanups and class/module/import/session fixture failures.
